faq: Do I need a Shopify Plus plan?

Most of this work, such as checkout customization, needs a Plus plan, billed by Shopify directly to you. If you are on another plan, tell us in the order form and we confirm what is possible before we start.
Can you work without touching my live checkout?
Yes. We build and test on a development store first, and move changes to your live store only when you approve. Checkout changes go live at a time you choose, so shoppers are not caught mid-order.

Plus projects can grow without end, so we fix the scope up front. Each package covers a set number of extensions, companies and Functions. Bigger programs are quoted separately, and we can plan them in stages.
Can you replace my old checkout scripts?

Yes. Shopify is moving checkout scripts to Functions and extensions. We read your current scripts, rebuild the logic in the supported way and test it. We cover what fits the package and quote the rest.
